critical_discrepancies.finding: Second-reviewed system 6 n001/n002 are written A2 in the printed bass clef, concert D2. Its F4/Bb3 reading assumes treble clef across a visible bass-clef change.

First reviewed systems 1 and 3-5 cannot be accepted as a complete note transcription. Overlaying their x/y on a 480 dpi direct render puts multiple asserted notes on stems, beams, rests, or empty staff positions.
The Vc., Cb. cue in system 3 is visibly preceded by a bass clef, contrary to the first-reviewed report's blanket treble-clef claim. Its cue pitches therefore need re-reading.
The first reviewed report classifies system-1 points n07-n10 as Horn part although they sit within the labeled Viol. I. cue passage and do not mark independent Horn heads.
The second reviewed report lists systems 6-11 noteheads but does not separate Ob. and Viol. I. labeled cue candidates from Horn part notes; this audit flags these groups.
Blanket eighth-note durations and ties from OMR were not accepted without rhythmic check against source.

uncertainties: The source image is legible for much of the coda but the first five systems need a fresh complete notehead inventory. Four systems remain unresolved; no whole-page count is claimed.
Cue boundaries in systems 6, 7, and 9 are tentative where labeled source notes are close in size to Horn notes.
Printed bass clef and one-flat change in system 3 require phrase-level pitch and accidental review; no pitch entries from this system are certified.
Duration, tie, and rest expansion fields are null where not independently verified.
method: Rendered the supplied PDF page directly at 240 and 480 dpi, inspected full page and system/half-system crops, overlaid prior candidate coordinates on the 480 dpi raster, used staff positions and printed local signs to challenge pitches and roles. Existing reports were comparison candidates, never sole authority.

playback_authorization.reason: Incomplete source notehead inventory in systems 1 and 3-5, confirmed clef errors in compared reports, and unresolved cue boundaries and rhythms. Do not use as Horn II playback data or final score export.
